name: Mercure Maldives Kooddoo Resort
desc: Mercure Maldives Kooddoo is a boutique adults-only resort with 68 villas in 7 categories, located in Gaafu Alifu Atoll, 55 minutes by scenic domestic flight. Rooted in Maldivian heritage, it offers international cuisine with meal plans including premium all-inclusive, bed & breakfast, and half-board. The house reef teems with marine life, and Vista, the Italian restaurant, offers stunning views. Relax by the pool or…

name: Pullman Maldives Maamutaa, All-Inclusive Resort
desc: Pullman Maldives Maamutaa, a generous five-star all-inclusive resort, offers a 65-minute flight from Male to Kooddoo Airport, followed by a 15-minute speedboat ride. Set on 18 hectares of tropical paradise, it features 122 villas and suites, including unique underwater options. Guests enjoy three restaurants, three bars, water sports and diving, fitness activities, and The Pullman Spa. Year-round events ensure…

name: Angsana Velavaru
desc: Perched on an expansive private lagoon in the virtually untouched South Nilandhe Atoll in the Maldives, and just a 40-minute seaplane journey from Velana International Airport, Angsana Velavaru (the island known as "Turtle Island" in the local Dhivehi language) is surrounded by sparkling turquoise waters and ocean views as far as the eye can see.

name: Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru
desc: Nestled in the pristine North Male Atoll, our secluded resort on a private island offers an immersive experience in the authentic local way of life. With a blend of distinctive design, delightful dining, nature-centric activities, and shared traditions, you can truly connect with the natural beauty both inland and underwater.

name: Dhawa Ihuru
desc: An island retreat set on North Malé Atoll with azure waters boasting jaw-dropping visibility, a spectacular sweep of powder- white beach, breathtaking sunset panoramas and a relaxed atmosphere, the reasons for staying at Dhawa Ihuru are crystal-clear.

name: SO/ Maldives
desc: SO/ Maldives is reinventing the luxury island getaway experience with bespoke villa collections on and sensorial experiences rooted in fashion and art. With diverse dining, a sophisticated playful beach club and serene spa all set in a private lagoon enclave, it's time to escape, explore and play. Inspired by the glamour of fashion world, SO/ Maldives is a lesson in inclusive luxury, perfectly suited to everyone…

name: Kuredhivaru Resort & Spa Maldives
desc: Kuredhivaru Resort & Spa, Maldives, is a private tropical haven offering inspiring moments, genuine comfort, and heartfelt service in one of the most luxurious destinations in the world. The spacious villas, with diverse dining options and various recreational facilities, cater to both couples and families. Enjoy high privacy alongside amenities like a spa, fitness centre, kids' club, and dive and watersports…

name: V Villas Maldives at Mirihi - MGallery Collection
desc: V Villas Maldives at Mirihi - MGallery Collection is an all-villa resort surrounded by the blues of the Indian Ocean on Mirihi, one of the Maldives' original islands. Designed by award-winning Studio Gronda, our 42 private villas embody a contemporary architectural language rooted in Maldivian heritage and nature.
